comparison.objective: Set a telescoping gauge to a bearing bore diameter and leave it on a stand; candidate screens media from workpieces.
comparison.physical_skill: Expand and lock a precision gauge against a bore, withdraw without changing span, and place it on a stand versus bulk pouring and orientation-dependent granular screening.
comparison.success_condition: Gauge span must be within 0.10 mm, tips clear, tool released and still, with full credit for correct stand placement across three lots. Candidate requires ≥98% recovered media, all washers retained, no loss/contamination/damage, and a released 3 s dwell. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Precision internal metrology and locked-span preservation are meaningfully different from separating many free bodies through apertures.
